datasets.name: BrEaST
datasets.description: A breast ultrasound dataset with image-level clinical, lesion-characterization, BI-RADS, diagnosis, and classification annotations.

datasets.name: BUS-UCLM
datasets.description: A breast ultrasound dataset with image-level diagnostic labels, Doppler and mark indicators, and segmentation-mask references.

datasets.name: BUS-BRA
datasets.description: A breast ultrasound dataset with image-level histology, pathology, BI-RADS, acquisition-device, laterality, bounding-box, and segmentation-mask annotations.

datasets.name: CMMD
datasets.description: A mammography dataset with patient demographics, study dates, image laterality, DICOM image metadata, and breast-side clinical abnormality, classification, and subtype annotations.

datasets.name: INbreast
datasets.description: A mammography dataset with image-level laterality, view, ACR, BI-RADS, finding summaries, lesion ROIs, pectoral-muscle boundaries, and case-level medical reports.
